title: Step 27's action itself (exhaust Mind Rune) behaved correctly: energy 0->1, rune shown rotated, resource bar 'Energy 1 Runes 1/2' matches runePools, legend ability and Retreat correctly became playable. However, in the AFTER screenshot Petal Pixie (unl-076-219) sitting alone in base displays an 'Effective Might' badge of 3 (base 2). The UI badge is base + meta.staticMightBonus etc., so the engine
expected: Parser: packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/parsers/static-parser.ts:647-681 matches "I have +N :rb_might: for each QUALIFIER"; parseForEachQualifier (lines 36-60) only recognizes two qualifiers (ven-097 "other units here with my name", ven-182 "token units you control"), so "of your units with [Temporary] at my battlefield" falls through to the fallback at line 669-681 emitting {type:'modify-might', amount:1, per:'of your units with [Temporary] at my battlefield', target:'self'} (verified by running parseAbilities on the card text). Engine: packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/static-abilities.ts:566-570 in applyStaticEffect treats `typeof rawAmount === "number"` as a flat amount and never reads `effect.per` (no reference to `per` anywhere in the engine abilities dir), then line 630-636 writes staticMightBonus += 1. UI badge at apps/riftbound-app/public/js/gameplay/render/card.js:220 sums base + staticMightBonus. Reproduced with harness: Petal Pixie (unl-076-219) alone at base with no Temporary units -> state shows staticMightBonus:1, might:3 (expected 2).
rule: unl-076-219 Petal Pixie (static 'for each' Might parsed as flat +1)
